data.description: Add a convention where consuming projects can place `<skill>-local/SKILL.md` files in their repo, and dso skills detect and reference them at runtime when present (no-op when absent). Inspired by oz-for-oss (https://github.com/warpdotdev/oz-for-oss/blob/main/docs/platform.md): they let cross-repo skills stay stable while per-repo companions override narrowly. Today dso overrides happen via CLAUDE.md prose or plugin forks — neither is a clean per-skill extension point. Scope: define the lookup contract, pick 1-2 pilot skills (e.g. code-reviewer, triage rubric), document the override surface, and ensure absent/frontmatter-only companions are treated as no-op.
data.title: Repo-local companion skill convention
